data.title: ADMINIT acceptance: compose reviewed A/B/E candidate with pinned manifest and physical gates
data.body:
п»їDownload lifecycle, record verification and historical coverage now have separate UI semantics. Measured decoded HTTP body bytes, per-job unique ingested/verified acknowledgments and monotonic throughput publish in the fenced PostgreSQL checkpoint after value/provenance rereads. Legacy jobs retain unknown counters and indeterminate progress; no fabricated99percent. Week/month downloads are bounded calendar-aware jobs. Approved OpenAPI remains unchanged.

ADMINIT installed source7b59b415760de83061cd8b91dc75f2f0e5c3878d, tree90944d6ba0dd0194999f82f50ec96f231ce5eff9, deploymentSHA256b4438d10495d65e684f9e40a7a29d68e114c772efd4df3edf969d1cb65d4823a. Real app/API and dedicated PostgreSQL services remain Running as LocalService. PG55470PID5132 and existing PG5432PID11740 unchanged; source596files/native1892files reverified.

Physical evidence on7b: real UI counters and distinct DownloadCOMPLETE/CoverageUNKNOWN; all13timeframes real candles+Volume through API/browserDOM;1800seconds240/240jobs/0failures/emptyqueue with complete resource samples; read-onlySQL proves two identical public downloadjobs preserve5unique rawrows and value/projectionhash. Soak is low-rate mixed controlled traffic,10simultaneous admissions/oneworker,not saturation. CPU/RAM/PGWAL/disk scopes are explicitly documented.

Published compact-reader candidate719b02eea4134730b5d688143022706a9cae8dbe, tree4e5d8c426ce76aa00f61032125eb6284d7b089ea, deploymenta1572b25fffd82ea5a4650ba57e76b5c66026a24f85d7f7149467c7f719552d2. It omits repeated proof documents only on opt-in lab reads; default B APIs and authenticity/UNKNOWN checks remain.430PASS/85SKIP/57subtests; Python3.12focused18PASS; unchangedfrontend20unit+27browserPASS. Portable read-only1000-row candidate exactly matches installed data/coverage/availability/provenance; profiled reader2.419s/79.2MBpeakWSS versus contextuallegacy5.769s/1.272GB. Candidate is NOTinstalled; no nativeHTTP speedup claimed.

Windows canceled the separately approved worker-recovery UAC; process never started and no worker was terminated. No automatic retry or further elevation request. Crash/restart/recovery remains NOT_RUN; ordinary nonadmin replay passed. ComputerUse stopped before physical mouse navigation because URL confidence policy could not be enforced; no workaround. F/G/H preparation is documented, and actual1440candle Fadmission rejected missing coverageevidence; no simulatedtrades were manufactured. Exact-sourceCI remains queued/superseded-cancelled, nativehostunsigned, fullhistory/saturation/keyring/physicalmouse/simulation gates absent. NOreleaseGO; mainunchanged.

Evidence: docs/adminit-acceptance/NATIVE_CONTINUATION_RESULT_2026_11_08.md, continuation-status.json, release-manifest.json, native-soak-30min-summary.json, native-nonadmin-replay.json, read-performance-portable-719-{profile,comparison}.json, strategy-real-market-preflight.json, native-ui-counters.json and native-ui-downloads.jpg. Installed vs prepared candidate vs PR evidence HEAD are deliberately distinct.

## ADMINIT continuation decision вЂ” 2026-11-08, exact PR head 24751fb768e9e940df8be7526eb854199f048064

Reviewed latest PR body and 4 PR-associated workflow runs (42485030582, 42485030595, 42485030589, 42485030591): all QUEUED, none PASS. User-reported and PR-published evidence: native installed 7b59b415..., job vs coverage statuses fixed; real all-13-timeframe checks; 30-minute low-rate soak 240/240 jobs, 0 failures; duplicate replay verified; portable reader 719b02ee... 79.2 MB peak vs 1.272 GB prior, NOT native installed. Keep installed SHA/candidate SHA/PR evidence HEAD distinct.

Next priority is **evidence-safe rollout of 719b02ee reader on ADMINIT**, not a forced upgrade. Inspect exact pinned source and manifest/hashes; ensure candidate retains #8 provenance/coverage/UNKNOWN semantics and the current native adapter; take dedicated test-owned backup/checkpoint; run fresh independent portable integration with B/E/API, then controlled stopв†’upgradeв†’startв†’read-only parity check. Do not change existing PostgreSQL5432, main, office network or unrelated services. If native packaging needs elevation, prepare one scope-specific UAC approval request; do not retry cancelled worker-recovery UAC automatically.

Prepare tests that distinguish 10 simultaneous admissions/one worker from true concurrent processing; benchmark 10 simultaneous symbols, queue fairness, bounded memory per worker, PostgreSQL WAL/size and mean/p95 API latency, with stop conditions. Add coverage-evidence fixtures for F admission rather than overriding the rejection; never fabricate historic completeness or execute real trades.

Crash/worker-recovery UAC was cancelled and code did not run: status remains NOT_RUN. Physical mouse was blocked by Computer Use: preserve status BLOCKED_TOOL, use available automated browser gesture tests as a separate evidence class (never claim physical input pass). Keep F/G/H NOT_INTEGRATED. CI queue: investigate runner labels, concurrency, permissions without mass reruns.

Report with exact source SHA, native SHA, payload hash, backup, deployment status, suite results, latency/resource baseline, failed gates and explicit GO/NO-GO. All code fixes GitHub-first; no local hotfix; PR remains Draft, no main merge.

workflow_definitions.yaml:
name: Platform acceptance
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, workstream/e-platform]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: platform-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: tester_ci
          POSTGRES_USER: tester_ci
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ephemeral-ci-only
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U tester_ci -d tester_ci"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    env:
      TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://tester_ci:ephemeral-ci-only@127.0.0.1:5432/tester_ci
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python: ['3.11', '3.14']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}
          cache: pip
      - run: python -m pip install 'pip>=26.2,<27'
      - run: python -m pip install -e '.[dev]' -c requirements-platform.lock
      - run: python scripts/acceptance.py --integration --security
  windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Parse PowerShell scripts
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Get-ChildItem scripts/windows/*.ps1 | ForEach-Object {
            $errors = $null; $tokens = $null
            [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($_.FullName,[ref]$tokens,[ref]$errors) | Out-Null
            if ($errors.Count) { throw ($errors | Out-String) }
          }
      - name: Isolated PostgreSQL, installer, start, acceptance, stop
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./scripts/windows/Test-Isolated.ps1

name: Storage integrity
on:
  push:
    branches: [workstream/b-integrity]
  pull_request:
    paths: ['src/storage/**', 'src/quality/**', 'tests/storage/**', '.github/workflows/storage.yml']
jobs:
  postgres:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        postgres: ['14', '18']
        python: ['3.11', '3.13']
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:${{ matrix.postgres }}
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: storage_test_admin
          POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd 'pg_isready -U storage_test_admin'
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}
      - run: pip install -r src/storage/requirements.txt
      - name: Matching backup tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y postgresql-common
          sudo /usr/share/postgresql-common/pgdg/apt.postgresql.org.sh -y
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y postgresql-client-${{ matrix.postgres }}
          echo "/usr/lib/postgresql/${{ matrix.postgres }}/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Unit, PostgreSQL, crash and backup tests
        env:
          TESTER_TEST_ADMIN_DSN: host=127.0.0.1 port=5432 user=storage_test_admin dbname=storage_test_admin connect_timeout=5
        run: python -m unittest discover -s tests/storage -v
      - name: Same-checkout B to E HTTP integration
        env:
          TESTER_TEST_ADMIN_DSN: host=127.0.0.1 port=5432 user=storage_test_admin dbname=storage_test_admin connect_timeout=5
        run: |
          python -m pip install -e . httpx
          python -m unittest tests.integration.test_trade_http -v

name: Frontend contract and fixture browser tests
on:
  pull_request:
    paths: ['frontend/**', '.github/workflows/frontend.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  fixture-browser:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: frontend
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - run: npm test
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: npm run test:ui

name: Python static and unit tests
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
      - run: python -m compileall -q .
      - run: python -m unittest discover -p "test_*.py" -v
  postgres-acceptance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:18
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: acceptance_admin
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-disposable
          POSTGRES_DB: postgres
        ports:
          - 55449:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U acceptance_admin -d postgres"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 12
    env:
      BYBIT_TEST_POSTGRES: "1"
      PGHOST: "127.0.0.1"
      PGPORT: "55449"
